title: THE STYLE MEDALS ARE EMBLEMS
why: His verdict on the party playtest was that the new features must be polished to the level of the older ones, and on the style medals he said to keep all of them but that they needed a UI overhaul, because Halo does medals well. A medal was a line of text on a small plate that rose over the cursor and was gone in under two seconds. Now each medal is an emblem of its own: a chamfered badge of beaten metal (copper for the plain medals, amber for the skilled ones, bright gold for the rare ones) with one picture that is its alone, a scope for LONG SHOT, a blade for MELEE KILL, two grenades for GRENADE DOUBLE, a skull for MULTI-KILL, a shield with a tick for UNTOUCHED, a burst for SCREEN CLEAR and two figures in team cyan for TEAM COMBO. The newest pops in large and settles with a ring flash and a sweep of light across the metal, the older ones slide along the row, and each stays up 4.2 seconds. The row sits at the left edge, in the clear stretch between the pillager board, the controls list and the feed, and the name and figure of the newest sit on a plate under it. The old text plates at the cursor are gone.
now: Each style medal is a metal emblem in a row at the left, the newest popping in with its name under it.
